description: Hand-maintained declarations for tools/parity/build_parity.mjs (docs/MAPLE_ISLAND_PARITY.md). categories.<id>.runtime and mechanics[].runtime declare the code an entry needs before it can be more than 'missing': every path or glob in files must exist and every contains marker must be found in a file matching its glob; partial names an older implementation that makes the entries 'partial' with its issue. A runtime declaration only says the code exists; evidence (parity-tagged checks) is what verifies an entry. mechanics[] are the Definition-of-Done rows that are not one canonical record each: category (default map-mechanics) places the row, accepts lists aliases (test keys that prove the same requirement; an alias may name no other entry and no other row's alias), real_game asks for a playtest check (true) or waives the category's need for one (false), source_gaps marks a documented source-data gap (the sources give no value). Keys of mechanics, cross_reference and canonical_verification are the parity keys tests tag (contract C6). canonical_verification[].requires names a state the shipped data must be in before the row can be more than partial ({"drops_schema_version": 2}: every drop record is schema v2, contract C1). playtest_tags gives parity keys to the hard checks of a scenario whose names match (scenario: report.json scenario name or names; match: a regular expression on the check name; keys: templates, $1..$9 are the match's groups; why: the review note). Every rule here was written against the check names of a real report and gives only keys the check proves; a rule that matches no check of its scenario's report is reported by the generator. out_of_scope maps a key to why Iteration Three leaves it out.
